non_dict_artifacts.reason: Empty-AI-reports sentinel file persisted as a JSON list; no body-level stamps applicable.  Tests rely on the empty list as a presence sentinel.

legacy_stamped_artifacts.reason: Kalshi source-health summary writer predates the canonical-stamp helper; existing tests pin the legacy field names.  Coherence is preserved (no execution implied).
